verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs say apps extend core functionality and integrate into the admin, online store and checkout. Community reports mention app charges added to merchants' bills, which implies a commercial app ecosystem. However, no evidence describes an app marketplace or store, any vetting or review process, or breadth of long-tail coverage. Missing for 10: documented app marketplace for merchants, app vetting/review process, evidence of long-tail feature coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of merchant app installation.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can extend my store from a marketplace of vetted apps and extensions covering the long tail of features

citations.quote: Extend Shopify's core functionality with apps that integrate into Shopify's admin, online store, checkout and more.
